# Processes

A process is a manufacturing method with the rules that matter for it, and values for each material. These ship with the workbench; in the Process Library you can change them, or add processes and materials of your own.

| Process | Family | Rules | Materials | You set up |
| :-- | :-- | --: | --: | :-- |
| [Plastic Injection Molding](plastic-injection-molding.md) | Injection Molding | 29 | 15 | Pull direction, Side actions, Nominal wall |
| [FDM](fdm-3d-printing.md) | FDM 3D Printing | 15 | 9 | Print direction, Nozzle diameter, Layer height |
| [Resin 3D Printing (SLA)](resin-3d-printing.md) | Resin 3D Printing | 15 | 3 | Print direction |
| [Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)](powder-bed-fusion.md) | Powder Bed 3D Printing | 16 | 5 | Nothing |
